description: Fix attempts for the R1 risk-tier baseline. The ticket and every fix were written for this demonstration; the copied lines are real platform code. One fix is right; the others are wrong in one way each, so each refusal is shown.

ticket.title: An unrecognised ticket risk tier clears every capability ceiling
ticket.description: riskTierIndex() returns 0 for a tier it does not recognise, so a ticket with risk_tier 'high' passes an R0 ceiling as though it were read-only. Example ticket written for this demonstration, not a production ticket.

reported_reason.message_includes: unrecognised tier cleared the R0 ceiling

edits.find: if (!ticketRiskTier) return true; // no risk tier set on the ticket = unrestricted
edits.replace:
if (!ticketRiskTier) return true; // no risk tier set on the ticket = unrestricted
  if (!RISK_TIER_ORDER.includes(maxRiskTier as any)) return false;

const t = RISK_TIER_ORDER.indexOf(ticketRiskTier as any), max = RISK_TIER_ORDER.indexOf(maxRiskTier as any);
  return t !== -1 && max !== -1 && t <= max;
